doc.name: A — bath textiles catalogue, weathered wood, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: waffle-weave bath towel stack
Category: bath textiles
Shot programme: weathered wood
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You are a commercial stills director briefing a bath textiles capture. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the floating levitation in a weathered wood treatment.

SUBJECT. A waffle-weave bath towel stack. Lock the product itself to the reference — no proportional drift, no invented branding, no cleaned-up typography. Everything else in the frame is your design decision.

CAMERA. Product suspended mid-air with no visible support and a soft drop shadow beneath. Shoot on a 45mm tilt-shift with the plane tipped at f/1.4, framing for a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with a hard fresnel through an egg-crate grid for a crisp-edged shadow. Stage the product on or against seamless paper sweep, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
